requirement: Data must be stored in China unless individual consent is obtained for cross-border transfer.
org_impact: MUST be a separate Salesforce org. This is a hard requirement — no exceptions.

connectivity_options.detail: VPN service via Orange and TATA Communications with local Chinese network providers. Provides encrypted tunnel between Salesforce data centers and Chinese endpoints.
Privately peered with China Telecom. Direct network path without traversing public internet.
ChinaCache — Chinese-licensed CDN for content delivery within China's network infrastructure.

requirement: Personal data must be first written/stored in Russia before it can be exported or replicated to systems outside Russia.
org_impact: May require a separate org or a Russia-first data write pattern. Evaluate with legal counsel.

requirement: Personal data must be stored in Turkey unless explicit individual consent is obtained for cross-border transfer.
org_impact: Can share an org if individual consent is obtained, but safest to plan for local data residency. Evaluate volume — if Turkey is a large market, consider dedicated org or regional grouping.

requirement: GDPR: Personal data may only be exported to countries with an 'adequate level of protection' as determined by the European Commission, or with appropriate safeguards (Standard Contractual Clauses, Binding Corporate Rules).
org_impact: EU countries can generally share a single org if the data center is in an EU/EEA region. Cross-region transfer (EU→US) requires legal basis. Hyperforce provides in-region data residency.

requirement: APPI (Act on Protection of Personal Information): Stricter than GDPR on cross-border data transfer. Requires PPC (Personal Information Protection Commission) adequacy finding or explicit individual consent per transfer purpose.
org_impact: Japan can share an APAC regional org if data center is in-region, but cross-border transfer to non-adequate countries requires per-purpose consent. Large Japan deployments may warrant dedicated org for compliance simplicity.

requirement: US export control and sanctions laws block access from embargoed countries. Users in sanctioned countries may require VPN or region-specific access workarounds.
org_impact: Users in embargoed countries cannot access US-hosted Salesforce orgs directly. Requires separate infrastructure or exemption.
